MODIS Aqua Corrected Reflectance true colour (bands 1-4-3), NASA GIBS daily mosaic of 2023-11-02, unchanged (no gaps in this box: 0.000 of pixels empty; isolated dark ocean pixels only)

grid: regular lat/lon (EPSG:4326, plate carree), 0.02 x 0.02 deg, row 0 = 70 N edge, col 0 = -50 E edge
overpass: Aqua daytime ascending orbits, ~13:30 local solar time: about 12:50 UTC at 10E, 13:20 UTC at 2E (Ciaran centre), 13:50 UTC at 5W, 16:50 UTC at 50W. Neighbouring orbits are ~99 min apart, so the daily mosaic has small time steps at orbit seams: one near 35-40W north of 55N, two near 5W-0 and 8-10E south of 45N; none crosses the storm spiral (centred near 53N 2.5E).
era5_map_time: The movie map is ERA5 2023-11-02T00 UTC (night). At image time the ERA5 MSLP minimum is near 52.5N 1.75E (12 UTC) to 53.5N 2.5E (15 UTC), i.e. over East Anglia / the southern North Sea, about 600 km ENE of its 00 UTC position (49.75N 5.75W).
alternatives: VIIRS SNPP 2023-11-02: 68 % empty (no data east of ~32W); VIIRS NOAA-20: 14 % empty (band north of ~66N); MODIS Terra (~10:30 local, ~3 h earlier) complete but with a bluish seam. Raw files under raw/NASA-GIBS/.
